company.name: Coal India
company.tag: Digs coal from open-cast and underground mines and sells it to power plants and factories
products: Washed coal (cleaned to lower the ash)
Solar power for its own use
Critical minerals and coal gasification projects
company.productNote: Coal types and sales routes named in Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report. Coal India's mining subsidiaries (Eastern, Bharat Coking, Central, Western, South Eastern, Northern and Mahanadi Coalfields) are consolidated into the group.

offerings.name: Open-cast mines
offerings.category: Huge pits where coal is dug out in layers
offerings.alt: An aerial view of a very large open pit coal mine cut into terraces — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Digging and loading
offerings.category: Machines that dig coal and load it onto trucks
offerings.alt: A large excavator filling a yellow mining dumper truck on a mine floor — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Coal faces
offerings.category: Layers of coal opened up and worked by machines
offerings.alt: A wide black coal mine floor with two yellow machines working on it — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Conveyors
offerings.category: Covered belts that carry coal to loading points
offerings.alt: An aerial view of blue covered conveyor belts crossing a mining area — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Draglines
offerings.category: Giant digging machines that clear rock above the coal
offerings.alt: A very large dragline digging machine with a long boom against a hazy sky — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Rail loading silos
offerings.category: Tall silos that fill railway wagons with coal
offerings.alt: A tall blue coal loading silo beside rail tracks in a green valley — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report

offerings.name: Command and control centre
offerings.category: A room that watches mine sites on screens
offerings.alt: A uniformed man at a desk in front of a wall of screens showing mine cameras — photograph from Coal India's 2025–26 integrated annual report
